en.title: DC Robotaxi Bill Overlooks Accessibility; MRT Damages Ramps; Disability Pride Honored
en.summary: The proposed robotaxi legislation in Washington, D.C. fails to include accessibility requirements for people with disabilities. Concurrently, construction on the MRT Yellow Line has damaged accessible ramps, undermining wheelchair access in the transit system. In Illinois, Disability Pride Month is being honored, highlighting advocacy for greater inclusion and accessibility.

zh-TW.title: 華盛頓機器人計程車法案忽視無障礙；高捷黃線毀坡道；伊利諾伊紀念殘障驕傲月
zh-TW.summary: 華盛頓特區提出的機器人計程車立法未將殘障人士的無障礙需求納入規定。同時，高捷黃線施工破壞了無障礙坡道，影響輪椅使用者的通行。伊利諾伊州紀念殘障驕傲月，肯定殘障人士的貢獻並呼籲擴大無障礙設施。
